explicit_reconstruction_needed.reason: Old torso combines shell and weak dark cut lines. Chest/waist/core split only records original pixels; continuous medium-bluegray internal volume must be authored once.
Original idle hides internal shoulder-bearing surfaces; source silhouette alone does not provide all rotated views.
Source forearm mask originally displaced separately. Rest source strips lack fixed visible medium-tone overlap through bend angles.
Upper-thigh side plates were owned by old torso. New thigh ownership preserves exact rest pixels, but original fixed-pose hidden hip coverage must be authored once.

Knee upper rim now stays in a single guard, tibial upper end follows shin; separately authored fixed upper/lower knee sleeves cover neutral hidden end faces and move by their own bones. Original RGBA layer composition excludes these sleeves.

reconstruction.verification_scope: All 23 neutral source layers preserve frozen original RGBA exactly; new fixed sleeve geometry and motion/art remain CANDIDATE.

notes: Head and chest source pixels are frozen. Their global position may move with body pose; visible owner mappings must prove source RGBA fidelity.
Hidden core/caps are separately authored candidate definitions. They are not included in the exact original-alpha composition proof.
Rest keypoints are local rig design choices, not engineering measurements of the imagegen diagrams.
Original torso lower side-plate pixels are reassigned semantically to thighs to avoid sliding leg armor with chest offsets; original RGBA remains unchanged.
v008 moves only enumerated original knee rim/tibial endpoint pixels between source layers. Source RGBA reconstruction remains exact.
Two fixed 4px knee sleeves follow their own upper/lower bones, share knee axis, and overlap by 2px; all new hidden material is authored once and still requires actual art review.
Original complete patella should cover steel sleeve; legacy dark core stays below. Do not hide steel with a closed black ring.

Explicit source_core_pixel_mask/source_armor_pixel_mask on knee and distal-thigh layers partition the original pixels exactly. Interior dark bore is below fixed steel sleeves; white guard and outer silhouette contour remain above. No frame-dependent mask changes.

fixed_joint_layering.rule: Assign the original patella material and matched outlines together above sleeve volume; split isolated legacy dark cut-line/internal-core pixels if needed, never place a whole closed black ring over the steel section.
fixed_joint_layering.source_uv_policy: Keep frozen original source UV and complete guard on one parent; physical pitch foreshortening is allowed, independent part realignment is not.
fixed_joint_layering.mask_consumer_rule: When source_core_pixel_mask exists, draw only those source pixels below sleeves and draw only source_armor_pixel_mask above sleeves. Both use the same original part UV and fixed parent bone; their unique mask union is the unchanged original part.

joint_endface_registry.hidden_extension: Upper 4px / lower 2px authored once, medium steel, axis overlap; no per-frame gap fill.
Upper 4px / lower 2px authored once, medium steel, axis overlap; no per-frame gap fill.

joint_endface_registry.review_requirement: Pelvis common medium structure must join both hip ends, visibly wider than a dark pin.
Original forearm guard must overlap the upper-arm endpoint; tool remains only the original 13 left-wrist brass source pixels.
Source shoulder shell overlays a visible medium load-bearing socket, with no full dark double contour.
Fixed ankle sleeve overlaps shin and boot; planted sole measured in model and projection separately.

projection_contract.model_foot_lock_vs_root_relative_cycle: Distinguish absolute world contact from root-relative in-place gait. Support source pixel is not alone a foot-lock/art proof.

source_material_masks.selection_basis: Manual semantic enumeration of interior dark bore/cut band, not output Alpha and not all dark source pixels.
